Get all container images used sorted unique
Get nodes sorted by internal IP address
Get all nodes in YAML format
Check Istio injection label on a namespace
output: kubectl get ns default -o yaml | grep istio-injection

instruction: Create a namespace and run a pod inside it
output: kubectl create ns testing && kubectl run test-pod --image=nginx --namespace=testing

instruction: Delete a namespace and all its resources
Get all pods with a specific annotation
output: kubectl get pods -A -o json | jq '.items[] | select(.metadata.annotations | has("sidecar.istio.io/inject")) | .metadata.name'

instruction: Run a command on all pods matching a label
output: kubectl get pods -l app=web-app -o jsonpath='{range .items[*]}{.metadata.name}{"\n"}{end}' | xargs -I {} kubectl exec {} -- hostname

instruction: Add an existing deployment to a kustomization
Set an environment variable in a deployment
Set a service account on a deployment
Update a service selector
Get the raw logs from a node's kubelet
output: kubectl logs -n kube-system kubelet-$(hostname) || journalctl -u kubelet -n 100

instruction: Check if a specific pod exists
List all container images by count
output: kubectl get pods --all-namespaces -o jsonpath='{range .items[*]}{.spec.containers[*].image}{"\n"}{end}' | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn

instruction: Get the age of all pods
List all container statuses with restart counts
